headline: Fierce Clashes Shake Callahan's Passage and Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Combat along the northern front lines has intensified over the latest watch. In Callahan's Passage, fresh engagements around The Crumbling Passage and Crumbling Post brought two base actions and over 1,400 combined casualties in the last two hours, with Colonial forces securing two strongpoints. Weathered Expanse remains the war's most violent cauldron, tallying five base changes across the last two hours amid furious fighting around Crow's Nest and Frostmarch, leaving one strategic base derelict in no-man's-land. While Mooring County recorded no new territorial flips since earlier morning actions, brutal attrition persists with more than 1,100 casualties logged in the past two hours under accelerating enlistment. Further east and west, casualty rates are surging across Palantine Berm, Nevish Line, and Stlican Shelf, signaling escalating pressure even as ownership remains unchanged since earlier assaults. In contrast, the southern interior and coastal islands remain entirely quiet.
